component.name: Herd
component.summary: Manage local llama.cpp models with a COSMIC app and panel companion

description.p: Herd manages local models through llama.cpp native presets and router controls. Its COSMIC application provides sidebar navigation and a model settings drawer; the panel companion offers quick controls and status.

Process Compose hosts the router independently of UI lifetime. Existing GGUF files are reused without implicit downloads or model eviction. Optional NVIDIA metrics describe the whole GPU, not an individual model.

Public Hugging Face search and file review support explicitly confirmed single-file GGUF downloads through llama.cpp, with progress, pause/resume and integrity checks before loading. Downloading never starts inference.
